metadata.description: Official Crunchbase company, people and funding search, filter and profile data

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Find official company identities. Search official Crunchbase names and resolve company, people, location or category identifiers. Returns profile URLs and descriptions; resolve ambiguous matches before fetching a profile.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Find official people, founders and executives. Search official Crunchbase names and resolve company, people, location or category identifiers. Returns profile URLs and descriptions; resolve ambiguous matches before fetching a profile.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Resolve Crunchbase location or industry identifiers. Search official Crunchbase names and resolve company, people, location or category identifiers. Returns profile URLs and descriptions; resolve ambiguous matches before fetching a profile.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Filter companies by industry, geography and funding. Filter official Crunchbase companies, people and funding rounds by industry, geography, date, funding amount or stage. Use cb_reference for valid fields, operators and collection IDs. Resolve location/category names to returned identifiers before filtering. Money is integer USD and dates are ISO dates. Preserve all user filters; never silently drop a filter. Simple public-field predicates only; private CRM/saved-list and recursive relationship filters are unsupported. One page of at most 15 results.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Filter people and professional profiles. Filter official Crunchbase companies, people and funding rounds by industry, geography, date, funding amount or stage. Use cb_reference for valid fields, operators and collection IDs. Resolve location/category names to returned identifiers before filtering. Money is integer USD and dates are ISO dates. Preserve all user filters; never silently drop a filter. Simple public-field predicates only; private CRM/saved-list and recursive relationship filters are unsupported. One page of at most 15 results.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Find funding rounds, amounts, stages and investors. Filter official Crunchbase companies, people and funding rounds by industry, geography, date, funding amount or stage. Use cb_reference for valid fields, operators and collection IDs. Resolve location/category names to returned identifiers before filtering. Money is integer USD and dates are ISO dates. Preserve all user filters; never silently drop a filter. Simple public-field predicates only; private CRM/saved-list and recursive relationship filters are unsupported. One page of at most 15 results.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Fetch company profile, founders, employees, board members, funding rounds and investors. Retrieve one identified organization, its description, website, headquarters, headcount, founders, employee profiles, board members and advisors, funding rounds, raised amounts and investors. Returns the available public relationship cards in one company-profile call; no separate people or funding search is needed for those cards.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Fetch official professional profile and company relationships. Retrieve one identified professional person, biography, current jobs, board roles, founded organizations and investments. Requires a person profile identifier, not a company identifier.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Fetch official funding round, amount and investor relationships. Retrieve one identified funding round, announcement date, investment stage, money raised, funded company and lead investors. Requires a funding-round identifier, not a company identifier.

services.name: Crunchbase
services.description: Read Crunchbase fields, collections and filter operators. Read the official Crunchbase schema before building filters: collections, company/person/funding fields, valid operators, enum values and relationship cards. Use returned paths verbatim. This returns schema documentation, not company records.
